contract.train: TRAIN_relevance_stream.jsonl only; DEV/HELDOUT evaluator-only, never fit.
contract.visible: Only each steps[].input in sequence and previous agent actions; no hidden laws, variant identities or sidecars.
contract.contrast: Identical critical instantaneous host observation across OLD x MID material laws and post-calibration {none, irrelevant_A, B_no_drift, B_flip}.
contract.outcome: B warning after latest B probe requires another host-executed B probe even when no physical drift. Unrelated A warning does not invalidate B evidence.
contract.actions: Legal host MOVE, PAINT_A, PAINT_B, ERASE, STOP, no invented action tokens.
contract.intervention: Long excursions/retraces execute in synthetic host; zero supervised weight. Alerts synthetically injected, never claimed native.
contract.scoring: Critical action split between current-paint and move-to-probe; full host completion, per-16-arm all-correct, false alarm handling; ablate surface and relative timestamp.
contract.leakage: Group by original v46 geometry_sha256 and split, event deltas once, evaluator certificates only in sidecars.
contract.negative: Current-only majority ceiling 50% at critical action; latest-probe-only ignores late B invalidation and is wrong for 50%.
contract.cross_release: v61 world family indices 700+; do not mix v61 held-out with v62 training.

limitations: Synthetic host, not native CyberSand. Late surface warning injected by experiment.
Timestamped per-surface symbolic event/probe controller solves benchmark; not neural performance.
Long detours are scripted zero-weight host interventions, not learned navigation.
No SLM trained, no native trial, no CPU neural latency/RSS or immutable Actions data artifact.
